name: Make Chart
description: Draw a chart from numbers you already have: bar (columns), barh (horizontal bars, best with long names), line (a trend over ordered categories, e.g. years) or scatter (x/y points). Saves an SVG in the workspace and shows it to the user; put it in a PDF with write_pdf as ![caption](file.svg). One chart answers one question: for two measures with different units make two charts.

title.description: What the chart shows, e.g. 'Sviluppo delle grotte di Borgio Verezzi (m)'

categories.description: bar/barh/line: the labels, one per value (names, years...). Max 60

series.description: The data. bar/barh/line: [{"name": "Sviluppo", "values": [1442, 250, ...]}], values in the order of categories, null for a gap; max 8 series. scatter: [{"name": "Grotte", "points": [[x, y], ...]}]; max 3 series

x_label.description: Optional axis title for x (with the unit)

y_label.description: Optional axis title for the values (with the unit)

path.description: Optional file name in the workspace (default: from the title, under _resources/)
